description: This file defines custom Cypress commands for functional testing, including data-driven testing helpers, login actions, element retrieval, and UI interaction simulations specific to the OrangeHRM project.

methods.name: ddtLoad
methods.description: Loads a dataset and iterates over the cases, executing a callback for each case.

methods.name: ddt
methods.description: Loads dataset cases and runs a provided test function for each case.

methods.name: login
methods.description: Performs a login action by visiting the login page and submitting username and password.

methods.name: loginTo
methods.description: Visits a specified URL and performs a login with given credentials.

methods.name: apiLogin
methods.description: Performs an API login request with provided credentials.

methods.name: getOXD
methods.description: Retrieves a specific OXD element by type.

methods.name: getOXDInput
methods.description: Retrieves an input element associated with a label, with logging.

methods.name: toast
methods.description: Checks for a toast message of a specified type with matching message.

methods.name: setValue
methods.description: Sets the value of an input or textarea element.

methods.name: isInvalid
methods.description: Checks if an element has an invalid state with a specific message.

methods.name: selectOption
methods.description: Selects an option from a dropdown element.
